##### Project general facts

Masaar 3 Laura by Arada is the third phase of the forested Masaar community, where villa and townhouse architecture is carefully integrated into the natural landscape. Contemporary facades blend harmoniously with generous green areas, while the homes rise from a ground floor to one or two upper levels. The collection offers townhouses with two to four bedrooms and spacious Signature and Forest villas with four and five bedrooms, each with private gardens, terraces and dedicated parking spaces.

The community is centred on a swimmable forest lagoon with a waterfall, surrounded by jogging and cycling tracks and an adventure trail through shaded green corridors. A family pool, a ladies-only community pool, basketball and padel courts, a wellness area, a duck pond and a children's adventure playground add variety, while a community centre, a mosque and the Zad food truck park create welcoming places to meet neighbours and enjoy everyday life.

Homes emphasise quality, comfort and modern functionality, with high ceilings, refined layouts and a strong focus on natural light and seamless indoor and outdoor living. Smart home technology and premium fittings run throughout, and spacious living areas are finished with high-quality materials and a contemporary aesthetic. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances including a cooking range, a hood and a washer-dryer, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste and making each home easy to personalise.

##### Location description and benefits

Masaar is a forested master-planned community in Sharjah, where homes are set among tree-lined green corridors, parks and shaded walking and cycling paths. Community pools, sports courts, play areas, cafes, a mosque and a community centre create a calm, family-oriented setting, while Masaar Central adds retail, dining and everyday services within easy reach of every neighbourhood.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Emirates Road connect residents with the rest of Sharjah, Dubai and the northern emirates. Masaar Central, Tilal Mall, Nasma Central Park and the Sharjah Mosque are a short drive away, while Sharjah International Airport, University City and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable driving distance, along with schools, clinics and hospitals serving local families.

Masaar is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the best-selling green residential destinations in the UAE. Spacious villas and townhouses surrounded by nature attract families seeking more space at accessible prices compared with Dubai. Low service charges, an established community and strong road links support steady demand from end users and tenants, underpinning long-term value for owners and investors.
